stem: Which sentence best expresses the controlling idea of the article?

options.label: F
options.text: But after such praise of their innate abilities, they collapse at the first experience of difficulty.

options.label: G
options.text: It adds up: trophy and award sales are now an estimated $3 billion-a-year industry in the United States and Canada.

options.text: Awards can be powerful motivators, but nonstop recognition does not inspire children to succeed.

options.text: Trophies were once rare things—sterling silver loving cups bought from jewelry stores for truly special occasions.
